name: Domain Search for WHMCS
author: Shipon Karmakar

sections.description:
Domain Search for WHMCS lets visitors search for domains directly from your WordPress site and hands them off to your WHMCS billing portal to complete registration. It is built for speed, ships with sensible defaults, and adds zero front-end JavaScript.

The 3.0.0 release introduces a redesigned admin dashboard, ZendForce brand styling, a built-in support center, and multiple under-the-hood security fixes.

Why this plugin

Most WHMCS integrations are heavy or hard-coded. This plugin is the opposite: a single, dependency-free shortcode that you can drop into a hero section, a sidebar, a Gutenberg block, or a page builder. Configure once and reuse across the site.

Features

  • Drop-in shortcode — paste [domain_search_for_whmcs] anywhere.
  • Multiple branded forms — create unlimited custom shortcodes, each pointing at a different WHMCS URL with its own placeholder text. Ideal for resellers and multi-brand hosts.
  • Modern admin dashboard — tabbed UI with a live “At a Glance” overview, click-to-copy shortcodes, and an in-product support center.
  • Built for speed — one tiny stylesheet on the front-end. No JavaScript, no jQuery, no external requests.
  • Theme-agnostic — semantic CSS classes you can target from any theme or page builder.
  • Secure by default — nonce verification, capability checks, sanitized I/O, and proper unslashing throughout.
  • Translation-ready — full text-domain coverage for localization.
  • Privacy-friendly — does not collect or transmit any data; the search submits directly to your own WHMCS install.

Perfect for

Web hosting providers, domain resellers, ICANN registrars, white-label hosting brands, and anyone running WHMCS who wants a polished domain search experience inside WordPress.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install it from the WordPress plugin directory.
  2. Activate Domain Search for WHMCS through the Plugins menu.
  3. Go to Settings → Domain Search for WHMCS and enter your WHMCS base URL.
  4. Paste [domain_search_for_whmcs] into any post, page, or widget area to display the form.
  5. Optional: from the Custom Shortcodes tab, create branded shortcodes that target different WHMCS installs.
sections.faq:
How do I change the WHMCS URL?

Open Settings → Domain Search for WHMCS and update the WHMCS URL field on the Default Settings tab.

Can I customize the placeholder text?

Yes. Each shortcode (default and custom) has its own placeholder field.

Can I have different search forms for different brands?

Yes — that’s what the Custom Shortcodes tab is for. Each custom shortcode has its own WHMCS URL and placeholder, and is referenced like [domain_search_for_whmcs id="sc_xxxxx"].

Does this plugin store any user data?

No. The plugin saves only your configuration (WHMCS URLs, placeholders) in the standard wp_options table. The search form submits the visitor’s query directly to your WHMCS site — nothing is logged or transmitted by this plugin.

Will it work with my theme or page builder?

Yes. The output is a small, semantic HTML form. It works in classic themes, block themes, Elementor, Beaver Builder, Bricks, Divi, and any builder that accepts a shortcode.

How do I style the form?

Use the Customization tab in the plugin to see the available CSS classes (e.g. .dsfwhmcs-domain-search-input, .dsfwhmcs-domain-search-button). Add your overrides in the Customizer’s Additional CSS, your child theme’s stylesheet, or a CSS plugin.

How do I get support?

Open the Support tab inside the plugin for direct email contact and the WordPress.org forum link, or email shipon@zendforce.com.

Does it work with the WHMCS REST/Domain Lookup API?

Not at the moment — the plugin hands off to WHMCS’s own cart.php flow rather than calling the API. This keeps the integration simple, fast, and dependency-free.
sections.changelog:
3.0.0

Major release: redesigned admin, brand refresh, security hardening.

  • New: ZendForce-branded admin dashboard — modular cards, tabbed navigation, click-to-copy shortcodes, and an “At a Glance” overview (custom shortcode count, active host, connection protocol).
  • New: built-in Support tab with direct email contact (shipon@zendforce.com), WordPress.org forum link, system info card, and a “before you contact” checklist.
  • New: logo mark, status pill, and a polished plugin footer with quick links.
  • New: translation-ready strings across the entire admin UI.
  • Fixed: uninstall.php was deleting stale option keys and left actual plugin data behind. It now correctly removes all plugin options on uninstall.
  • Fixed: removed a non-functional WordPress nonce from the front-end search form. Because the form posts to an external WHMCS URL, the nonce could never validate — it was just a leakable token on every page.
  • Changed: the search form now submits via GET (matching WHMCS cart.php convention) and opens in a new tab with rel="noopener".
  • Hardened: explicit current_user_can('manage_options') checks on the settings handler and rendering function. Safer sanitization on $_GET parameters and shortcode IDs (sanitize_key).
  • Improved: admin assets only load on the plugin’s settings page; asset versions are tied to the plugin version for clean cache busting.
  • Removed: stray https:/ directory that was accidentally bundled in earlier releases.
  • Internal: introduced DSFWHMCS_VERSION, DSFWHMCS_FILE, DSFWHMCS_DIR, and DSFWHMCS_URL constants for cleaner internals.

2.1.0

  • Redesigned admin dashboard with a modern, card-based UI and tabbed navigation.
  • Fixed: uninstall.php removes the correct option keys.
  • Fixed: removed the unused nonce from the front-end search form.
  • Changed: search form submits via GET and opens in a new tab.
  • Hardened: explicit capability checks; safer sanitization of $_GET['message'].
  • Improved: admin assets only load on the plugin’s settings page.
  • Removed: stray https:/ directory bundled in prior releases.

2.0.0

  • Added admin settings for WHMCS URL and placeholder text.
  • Improved security with nonce verification.
  • Enhanced shortcode management functionality.
  • Optimized code for better performance and compatibility.
  • Added the ability to create and delete multiple shortcodes.
  • Improved admin panel UI for better user experience.

1.5.0

  • Improved shortcode functionality.
  • Added basic security improvements.
  • Fixed minor styling issues.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
